decisions.reason: The multi-model operator line is a core accessory to the garage door business, though operator generations are refreshed regularly and models may be replaced.
The solid wood sectional door is a low-volume premium niche, but it rounds out the residential range at little cost, so it stays despite some risk of rationalisation.
The remote-controlled operator still supports garage door sales, though it is the most likely to be merged into the broader operator line.
The insulated glazed industrial door matches rising energy-efficiency requirements for commercial buildings and fits the firm's thermal focus.
Since Product D was withdrawn, this glazed industrial sectional door is the main standard glazed option and remains an important part of the industrial range.
